query: UPDATE phone_numbers SET e164 = $2, owner_user_id = $3, agent_id = $4, label = COALESCE($5, label), greeting = COALESCE($6, greeting), enabled = COALESCE($7, enabled), deliver_group_chat_id = $8, transfer_e164 = $9, notice = $10, transcript_days = $11, log_days = $12, record_calls = $13, recording_days = $14, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1
